hypothesis: Bayesian Optimization selects hyperparameters to reduce hallucination in large language models while preserving fairness in output generation
description: This approach models the trade-off between hallucination reduction and fairness as an optimization problem, using a probabilistic surrogate to guide efficient search across complex, expensive evaluations; it adapts to model behavior without requiring labeled data, leveraging historical performance to steer improvements where they most benefit equity and accuracy.
